layout.arrangement: Title top-center; yellow slide-number badge top-right; three full-width blue-outlined light-gray panels stacked vertically with white gaps. Top and middle panels are split left/right: left has a math label above a 3x3 matrix table, right has a determinant/conclusion chain. Bottom panel has the regularized-inverse expression on the left, a long right arrow, and the resulting inverse matrix table on the right.

regions.name: title_header
regions.content: Dark red bold title 'Inverse Problem of Singular Matrix'

regions.name: top_panel
regions.content: Singular matrix example: X^T X matrix, determinant zero, conclusion 'No Inverse'

regions.name: middle_panel
regions.content: Regularized matrix example: X^T X + λI with λ=3, highlighted diagonal, determinant 5685, conclusion 'Inverse Exists'

regions.name: bottom_panel
regions.content: Inverse of regularized matrix: (X^T X + λI)^-1 followed by the inverse matrix

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates by size and dark red color. The three panels are visually equal containers. Within panels, the left matrix and right conclusion chain are balanced; yellow diagonal highlights and red italic conclusions provide secondary emphasis.

visual_elements.description: Top blue-outlined light-gray panel containing the singular-matrix example.
Top 3x3 matrix under red label X^T X. Row 1: 14, 10, 15 with a small diagonal slash artifact visible near 15; Row 2: 10, 40, 46; Row 3: 20, 80, 92. Black cell borders and centered black numerals.
Two black right arrows in the top panel chain: |X^T X| = 0 ⇒ Singular Matrix ⇒ No Inverse.
Middle blue-outlined light-gray panel containing the regularized non-singular matrix example.
Middle 3x3 matrix under label (X^T X + λI) with λ=3. Row 1: 17, 10, 15; Row 2: 10, 43, 46; Row 3: 20, 80, 95. Diagonal entries 17, 43, and 95 are highlighted yellow.
Two black right arrows in the middle panel chain: |X^T X| = 5685 ⇒ Non-Singular Matrix ⇒ Inverse Exists.
Bottom blue-outlined light-gray panel containing the inverse-matrix result.
Long black right arrow from (X^T X + λI)^-1 to the inverse matrix table.
Bottom 3x3 inverse matrix. Row 1: 0.07, 0.04, -0.03; Row 2: -0.01, 0.23, -0.11; Row 3: -0.01, -0.2, 0.11. Black cell borders and centered black numerals.

typography_notes: Serif font throughout, Cambria/Times-like. Title is bold, larger, and dark red. Math expressions use mixed colors: X^T X in dark red, + λI in blue, λ=3 in green. Conclusions 'No Inverse' and 'Inverse Exists' are red italic. Matrix numerals are black and centered. Slide number is black inside a yellow circle.
animation_state: No build or animation state is apparent; all elements are fully visible.
recreation_brief: 1) Use a 16:9 white slide. 2) Add a centered title text box at the top: 'Inverse Problem of Singular Matrix', bold serif, about 32-36 pt, color #8B0000. 3) Add a yellow circle at the top right with black text '21'. 4) Add three full-width rectangles with blue #0000FF outlines and light gray #F2F2F2 fills, stacked with white gaps. 5) Top panel: place red serif label 'X^T X' on the left; below it insert a 3x3 table with black borders and values 14, 10, 15 / 10, 40, 46 / 20, 80, 92. On the right add '|X^T X| = 0', a black arrow, 'Singular Matrix', a black arrow, and red italic 'No Inverse'. 6) Middle panel: place '(X^T X + λI)' with X^T X in dark red and + λI in blue; place green 'λ=3' to its right. Below insert a 3x3 table with values 17, 10, 15 / 10, 43, 46 / 20, 80, 95, and highlight diagonal cells 17, 43, 95 in yellow. On the right add '|X^T X| = 5685', a black arrow, 'Non-Singular Matrix', a black arrow, and red italic 'Inverse Exists'. 7) Bottom panel: place '(X^T X + λI)^-1' on the left with the same red/blue coloring; add a long black right arrow; on the right insert a 3x3 table with values 0.07, 0.04, -0.03 / -0.01, 0.23, -0.11 / -0.01, -0.2, 0.11. 8) Keep all text serif, matrices centered, and all content static with no animation.
